group_assessment.weighting: Single tertiary paediatric neurology centre, retrospective 20-year neonatal-onset pharmacoresistant epilepsy cohort; two co-authors also co-author a held multi-centre WWOX phenotype series, which makes patient overlap plausible (INFERENZA, see dossier).

field_density.note: Twelve PubMed records pair WWOX with neonatal; this cohort adds a gene count, not a genotype.

multihop.note: 27 references enumerated from the JATS back matter; none names WWOX. The WWOX content is the cohort's own count (Figure 2 legend and Discussion), not a citation, so no hop is owed.

entries.proposition: WWOX accounts for two of the 56 patients of this neonatal-onset pharmacoresistant MRI-negative cohort, listed among the 'other anomalies'; no genotype is printed.
entries.anchor: Figure 2 legend (genetic causes among the cohort)

entries.proposition: The authors place WWOX among the rare 'other anomalies' outside the three recurrent genes and report no correlation between having a genetic anomaly and neurodevelopmental outcome; no per-gene outcome is given.
entries.snippet: including mutations in genes such as GABRB3, ATP1A3, and WWOX

entries.proposition: No per-gene outcome analysis: the presence of a genetic anomaly was not correlated with neurodevelopmental outcome.
entries.snippet: no clear correlation was observed between the presence of a genetic anomaly and the neurodevelopmental outcome

entries.proposition: Denominator: 35 of the 56 patients had a pathogenic genetic variant.
entries.snippet: Pathologic genetic variants were found in 35 (62.5%) of the patients in our cohort

entries.proposition: Cohort mortality was six of 56, all before five years; deaths are not attributed to genes.
entries.snippet: Six patients (11%) died during the study period

entries.proposition: WWOX is a gene on the diagnostic panel listed in Appendix S1, so the two WWOX diagnoses were reachable by the panel used for all patients.
entries.snippet: CHRNB2 GABRG2 KCTD7 PNKP SLC9A6 WWOX
entries.anchor: Appendix S1, gene list table, sixth column, second-to-last row (rendered page, no text layer)
